allowed: nonsecret Azure resource and object identifiers required to verify least authority
quoted ETags and immutable version IDs
HTTP status codes and response-body SHA-256 digests
timestamps and the one-shot authorization identifier
forbidden: storage account or Shared Key credential
raw public operator IPv4 address or CIDR
raw OIDC token or unredacted claims

rules: Every object has an exact field set; missing and additional fields fail closed.
Every hash is lowercase SHA-256 over canonical newline-terminated JSON or exact response bytes as labelled.

The terminal receipt binds the canonical authorization, reviewed head, merged main, common tree, executor, plan, deterministic package, Azure account object, full mutation universe, component digests and S2 evidence-file digests.
The terminal receipt is successful only when failures and pendingHousekeeping are both empty and no production release mutation occurred.
Permanent mutation IDs occur exactly once and equal the non-temporary provider mutation universe in the reviewed plan.

Temporary package IPv4 and each authorization-specific custom package, key-read, activation-fence and controller-canary role definition and assignment are executor-owned, removed, freshly reread and absent before bridge start.

A pre-existing exact-private controller-lock container is never adopted from ARM metadata alone: it remains adopt-pending-execution-empty-proof until a bounded Azure AD list read, performed after only the uploader IPv4 and controller role are added, proves one unpaginated zero-blob inventory and retains the canonical URL, response digest, timestamp and private ARM posture.

Activation-fence evidence distinguishes a current-authorization If-None-Match:* HTTP 201 create from exact immutable adoption with no current write; either path leaves the canonical idle fence Available and Unlocked.

Package evidence distinguishes a current-authorization If-None-Match:* HTTP 201 upload from exact immutable version adoption with no current write, and binds deterministic versioned Azure AD readback; SAS, account keys and package bytes are never retained.

Bootstrap managed-identity proof is one fresh exact source-and-package-pinned WebJob invocation reaching terminal Success under the exact control and settings, with ARM invocation metadata, pre-run history boundary, fence cleanup, and a source-derived expected-marker digest; it does not claim HTTP index/live/ready/app-health/security or literal stdout-marker observation.
Controller and activation leases are finite; fast-lane and expiry-fallback cleanup canaries both complete and leave no lease or housekeeping obligation.
Accepted-release, result and package containers are private Locked WORM projections at no less than 91 days with append-write flags false; an already stricter retention is never downgraded.

The separate required S2 terminal bundle retains the full canonical component and proof bodies plus the five evidence-file descriptors and terminal receipt, never a digest of itself; the S2 Git commit seals it.
Generated outputs remain local until one independently reviewed evidence-only S2 commit; source logic and resource policy cannot be changed by that commit.
